g.text: Judge results differ sharply on Base responses

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51626e

g.text: Same 159 behaviors in each condition. Percent labeled unsafe; both panels use the same 0-100% scale.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #51626e
font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51626e

g.text: HB: successful exhibition of the specified behavior.

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51626e

g.text: LG: unsafe content under its category policy.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51626e

g.text: The judges measure different constructs; neither is adjudicated ground truth. Low HB rates do not establish safety.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51626e

g.text: Base inputs all begin with duplicate BOS tokens. Exact historical Instruct generation linkage is unverified.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #51626e

g.text: This is a common-judge, same-behavior corpus comparison, not a clean causal Base-versus-Instruct ablation.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #192c3a
